item: 1.33 — live output of a running foreground command: what it has printed so far shows as its OUT row while the call runs; the settled OUT row replaces it (2026-11-22)
branch: js/70-events.js startLiveOut (task_started{is_backgrounded:false, tool_use_id} on a tool line still .run → one 'taskOutput' ask at once, then one a second) · paintLiveOut (the __taskOutput answer draws / updates .io-row.io-live in the line's own .io box; no row before the first byte; an error ends it) · endLiveOut on tool_result (75-retraction.js), task_notification, task_updated{is_backgrounded:true} and at the CLI boundary (liveOutReset) · the roster pane's __taskOutput path (11.7) untouched for other ids
provenance: The task_started frame is the CLI's own, copied from a stdio tape of 2026-11-22 (2.1.330, panel flags, haiku, a foreground `for i in 1..7; do echo tick $i; sleep 2; done`): it arrived 3.2 s after the approval with {task_id, run_id, tool_use_id, description, is_backgrounded:false, task_type:'local_bash'}; nothing else arrived until task_notification{status:'completed'} and the tool_result, and get_task_output{task_id} asked once a second in between answered {output:'tick 1\ntick 2\n', total_bytes:14, truncated:false} growing to 49 bytes — the output / total_bytes / truncated values in the __taskOutput frames here are those answers. __taskOutput itself is OUR OWN Kotlin->webview frame (11.7, unchanged). The tool lines are built with the real toolLine / ioBox builders and registered in toolsById the way the stream handler registers them (the gallery's idiom); window.__bridge is wrapped while frames that would ask Kotlin are fed, so the sandbox CLI is never asked about these invented task ids. The tool_result is fed as a real user frame through onClaudeEvent. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-11-22 against the pre-change webview (the sandbox on f681aea; `typeof startLiveOut` read 'undefined'): 15 passed / 13 failed — the twelve DISCRIMINATING asserts and the guards that need a row or the liveOut map (label, fold, tracked) failed; the fixture is null-safe there (liveOut / liveOutTick / liveOutReset are looked up with typeof).

steps.note: task_started for a running foreground call asks for its output at once; the first answer draws the live OUT row in the line's own box, the next one updates it in place
